_comment: Differs from oci-clean in ONE way: the registry-url names a DIFFERENT repository. A container registry tag body carries no repository identity, so without this binding one faithfully recorded response certifies any allowlisted name -- an attacker records their own repo response and claims to be something already on the allowlist.
name: acme/oci-tool
publisher-auth: registry namespace oci-tools, push gated on the upstream repository identity
build-attestation: SLSA Provenance v1 in-toto attestation present in the image index
